content: {"episode_id":"ep-05099","cpt":"93247","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"I request reconsideration of the denial for CPT 93247, which was denied under CO-197 because required prior authorization was not obtained. The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations and lightheadedness in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and a significant history of transient ischemic attacks. Given concern for intermittent arrhythmia contributing to cerebral hypoperfusion, long-term continuous ECG monitoring was ordered to correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances."}
